chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, whenever he intended war, would call his wives, consult them, then act contrary to them.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله deal with consulting his wives before war?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله in which he would consult his wives when intending war. It reflects an instance of consultation within the household in connection with matters of decision-making.
